method.shape: one warm page, configs switched at runtime, visited round-robin over 3 passes, medians compared
controls: GTAO forced off (its half_rate schedule alternates frame cost and draw calls on a 2-frame cycle)
shadow caster culler parked so the caster set cannot drift
400-frame burn-in before sampling; 250 frames + 3.5s settle after each config switch (material recompiles)
method.why: per-page comparison is invalid: a fresh browser warms up across loads (off measured 19.15ms first, 4.42ms last in one run)

conclusion.bottleneck: vertex/geometry throughput - the city's triangles are transformed once per cascade

ruledOut.drawCallSubmission: ~1 ms live for a 44% draw call cut (the caster merge)
ruledOut.perPixelReceiverWork: rejected: shadow delta did not fall with viewport area
ruledOut.treeShadows: 0.1-0.7 ms, ~310 draw calls, inside the noise floor
ruledOut.CSM_FADE: under 1 ms, not resolvable above per-state spread

conclusion.remainingLever: reduce triangles submitted to the far cascades (shadow-caster geometry LOD), or reduce cascade count
